mentions.name: ageinx
mentions.description: A simple, secure hosted authentication service aimed at frontend-focused developers and beginners, designed to be set up in about two minutes. It requires no SDK (just redirection), stays fast, charges no monthly active user (MAU) tax, and offers a $29 lifetime deal for its first 15 users.
mentions.audience: Frontend-focused developers and people starting development who need quick, simple auth setup
mentions.source_excerpt: i am building ageinx , https://ageinx.vercel.app , it is a simple secure hosted auth , frontend focused or someone who is starting development can get it done in literal 2 minutes because of simplicity.
